details:
With more and more users using the Dolly cams, you end up with a bunch of cams always running on paths that end up going through you / being distracting.

Having an easy one click setting to hide all other user's dolly cams would be good.

(a different setting than for the regular cams, knowing where other's regular cams are is usefull for group photos and such.)

Maybe also disable them by default after displaying a user warning / giving the user the choice to keep them the first time to point out the new setting.

Or another way to do it , could be to only show them when you have the user menu open 

(like currently it only shows the cams direction field of view in red, 

The dolly could be totally hidden by default and only be shown when the menu is open) 

I for one would like to use the dolly more, keeping it running in the background and recording but not if it means annoying others by having the cam running through them and be invasive.

As for "privacy" concerns: 

world cams / avatar user cams, are already never shown, so having the dolly hidden is not really impacting privacy more.

And it being a user setting, those worried about their "privacy" could still turn them back on.

Headsets like quest can also record / take screen shots without anyone knowing too anyway.
title: [1584] [Dolly] Easy way to hide running dolly cams
